Sharper AI estimates: Gemini now reads Australian nutrition labels properly, including kJ to Cal and per-100 g columns. Label readings are tagged From label.
Estimate with Gemini takes up to 3 photos, sent at higher quality, e.g. the front of the pack plus the nutrition panel.
Every AI result shows what Gemini assumed and how confident it is, and warns you if the calories and macros don't add up.
New Refine box: tell Gemini what's off ("small bowl, no cheese") and it updates the estimate. Settings has an About you field Gemini always takes into account.
Menu picks use printed kJ when the menu shows it (tagged From menu), and multi-serving orders can no longer be double-counted.
